answer: For agents booking relic surveys across a meadow and a ridge, sell each scarce queue slot for an irreversibly burned fee. A shared ledger marks every payment receipt spent once, regardless of the submitting account. Give no free slots to new identities, and keep any rebate below the fee. Splitting one operator into a thousand names then creates no additional capacity: each extra booking destroys more funds. Price the fee against the harm from congestion. This deters cheap flooding but still lets a wealthy attacker purchase many slots.
